# netcup_clouddns_acme_challenge (Resource)

An ACME challenge of a domain on CloudDNS (netcup API).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netcup_clouddns_acme_challenge" "www" {
  domain_id = 12345
  scope     = "www"
  value     = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789_-ABCDE"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (Number) Id of the domain, from the `netcup_clouddns_domain` data source.
- `scope` (String) `@` for the zone apex or a hostname label.
- `value` (String) Challenge value, 43 characters of base64url.

### Read-Only

- `fqdn` (String) Name of the challenge record.
- `id` (String) Composite id `domain_id/scope/value`.
- `status` (String) Status of the challenge.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import format: <domain_id>/<scope>/<value>
terraform import netcup_clouddns_acme_challenge.www 12345/www/abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789_-ABCDE
```
